name: MAC-G-the-tolerance-read-takes-immunity-before-resistance
why: GetTolerance reads resistance first (DFCareer.cs:746-762), but cannotAdd makes two tolerances on ONE effect impossible, so no career the game can build distinguishes the two orders. Kept as the reference's order; recorded as equivalent rather than pinned by a career that cannot exist.

name: MAC-G-the-default-magery-is-announced
why: DFU guards the magery line on Times_0_50 explicitly (DaggerfallCharacterSheetWindow.cs:616). Here MAGERY_MULT_BITS has no entry for 20, so the lookup already answers null and the guard is the reference's shape rather than a load-bearing branch. Kept because the pair says what the code means, and a table that ever gained a Times_0_50 row would need it.
